originals.why: Welsh 'mae gen i ormod o waith' does not contain the LEGO 'mae ’na ormod o', so it is not a USE of this LEGO. A Korean prompt built on the gloss 'too many ~ there are' would also pull the learner toward 'mae ’na ormod o waith' (two possible answers).

topups.why: 'the story in my head' is a weaker phrase, and the 4 USE slots are already filled.
'아직' could be heard as 'eto' rather than 'hyd yn hyn', so the prompt has two possible answers.
The Korean '내 머릿속에 무언가가 있어' could also be 'mae ’na rywbeth', so it does not lock 'mae gen i'. It also reads oddly.
